name: Dire Weasel

Special attacks and qualities.name: Attach
Special attacks and qualities.effectNote: On a successful bite, the dire weasel latches onto the target. It loses its Dexterity bonus to Armor Class while attached, leaving it at AC 12.

Special attacks and qualities.name: Blood drain
Special attacks and qualities.effectNote: The dire weasel deals 2d4 temporary Constitution damage each round it remains attached.

Encounters.name: Southwestern sacks
Encounters.effectNote: The dire weasel hides in the southwestern sack pile. After two rounds it attacks the nearest character on round three. A character spots it by winning an opposed Spot check against its Hide roll. It leaves its kobold handlers alone.

Encounters.name: Contagious in this adventure
Encounters.effectNote: A creature that comes into contact with this animal must make a DC 13 Fortitude save against the Burning Plague. See the adventure’s disease rules on pp. 3–4.

notes: The encounter prints HD 3d8+0 and Constitution 6.
Miguel Duran, The Burning Plague (Wizards of the Coast, 2000), Area 4: The Larder, pp. 7–8.

name: Rat
appearance: A tiny rat from the larder at Duvik’s Pass.

Special attacks and qualities.name: Scent
Special attacks and qualities.effectNote: The rat detects nearby enemies by smell. The adventure refers to the Dungeon Master’s Guide for the general scent rules.

Encounters.name: Barrels 2 and 5
Encounters.effectNote: Four rats hide in each barrel. They stay inside until disturbed, then attack. Each of the eight rats has 1 HP.

Encounters.name: Contagious in this adventure
Encounters.effectNote: A creature that comes into contact with this animal must make a DC 13 Fortitude save against the Burning Plague. See the adventure’s disease rules on pp. 3–4.

notes: The adventure prints CR 1 on the collective Rats (8) line. It gives no CR for a single rat.
The rat’s printed bite is 1d3 - 4. Its Hide modifier is +18.
Miguel Duran, The Burning Plague (Wizards of the Coast, 2000), Area 4: The Larder, pp. 7–8.
